critique: The palette and black background remain fire-appropriate, but the motion from frame 1 to frame 4 is still an almost perfectly symmetric expanding burst. Frame 4 is especially explosion-like: flame sprites occupy a broad circular field around the bright center, rather than forming a compact, tapered plume behind a traveling rocket direction. The isolated large flame chunks further read as debris, not a coherent fire trail.

suggestions.why: Switch the emitter-direction mode away from the current outward/radial behavior to a directional emission mode so particles share a rocket-travel axis instead of expanding evenly around the origin.
Remove velocity variation that is spreading the fire sprites laterally and breaking the trail silhouette.
Reduce the oversized isolated sprite chunks so the effect reads as a dense tapered flame plume rather than explosion debris.
